name: tty-clock
summary: ncurses digital clock for a terminal pane (seconds, date, centered, blinking colon). Color is one of the 8 ANSI colors, so it follows the terminal palette. No Windows build: use clock-tui there.

windows.notes: ncurses program with no Windows build or package (not in winget or scoop). Use clock-tui (tclock) on Windows.

install.notes: Arch: AUR only (no official pacman package).
Fedora: no dnf package found on Repology; build with make (needs ncurses-devel, gcc, make).

theme.notes: -C 0-7 picks an ANSI color; the hex comes from the terminal palette.

config.notes: Flags only: seconds, date, box, centering, blink, refresh.
